name: asap7_rvt_tt_v1
description: v1 Boolean-layer area flow: SystemVerilog -> generic one-bit gates (NOT/AND/NAND/OR/NOR/XOR/XNOR/MUX + DFF) -> ASAP7 RVT TT cells via dfflibmap + ABC. Change anything here => bump `version` (results are only comparable within one profile).
notes: synth -flatten lowers processes, memories (to flops + muxes) and word-level ops to one-bit gates.
dfflegalize rewrites enable / sync-reset flops into plain DFFs + MUX gates so the Boolean graph has only the listed dff_types; latches and other sequential cells are rejected.
abc -g restricts the generic gate set; NOT is always available to ABC.

`keep` on flop Q wires keeps register names through dfflibmap/abc so the mapped netlist can be matched wire-for-wire against the Boolean graph in the equivalence check (an inverter after a QN-only cell is then not merged into downstream logic).
Equivalence is checked outside this script by bool_area.py: RTL vs Boolean graph and Boolean graph vs mapped netlist, both with equiv_simple + equiv_induct (fallback: bounded miter/SAT).
